name: Psych-Aware Free
summary: Self-contained Chinese-first instructions for everyday support, study planning and clear communication, with four optional methods and inline research boundaries.
scope: A reduced free edition, not the complete 100-entry reference collection. All operational instructions are in SKILL.md; no relative file paths, execution scripts, API keys or telemetry. Includes implementation intentions, retrieval practice, distributed practice, and factual interpretation checking with a limited reappraisal research background. No diagnosis, therapy, medication advice, clinical efficacy claim, guaranteed improvement, or always-on promise. Host behavior determines activation and persistence; cross-model and cross-language reliability have not been established.
